title: Limit Breaker
description: It will Break Limit of Minecraft
body:
# ⚡ LimitBreaker SMP

Break Minecraft’s limits. Become superhuman. Power grows with survival.

**LimitBreaker SMP** is a unique Minecraft plugin where players gain power the longer they survive without dying. Instead of custom items or pay-to-win mechanics, progression is based on skill, time survived, combat, and exploration.

As you level up, you break vanilla Minecraft limits — moving faster than normal players, jumping higher than ever possible, mining faster than Haste II, attacking with superhuman speed, and even seeing entities through walls.

Death has consequences — lose levels and power — making survival intense, rewarding, and competitive.

## 🚀 Core Features
# 🧬 Survival-Based Power System

- Gain Breaker Levels by staying alive

- Death reduces levels

- Rewards skill, strategy, and experience

## ⚡ Limit-Breaking Abilities

- Faster movement beyond vanilla limits

- Higher jumps & reduced fall damage

- Mining faster than Haste II

- Faster attack speed & combat buffs

- Entity vision (see mobs & players through walls)

- Superhuman abilities at high levels

## ⚔️ PvP Power Stealing

- Killing a player lets you steal their power level

- High-level players become server threats

- Creates rivalries and intense PvP moments

## 🧠 Playstyle Evolution Paths

1. Players naturally evolve into builds like:

2. Fighter

3. Speed Runner

4. Miner

5. Tank

6. Hunter

## 🌎 Scaling Difficulty

- Mobs become stronger as players grow

- Late-game players feel powerful but challenged

## 🔥 No Custom Items

- 100% vanilla gameplay

- No resource packs

- Lightweight & optimized

## 🎮 Perfect For

✔ SMP Servers
✔ PvP Servers
✔ Hardcore Worlds
✔ YouTube / Content SMPs
✔ Competitive Communities

## 🛠️ Admin Tools

1. Level management commands

2. Player stats viewer

3. PvP steal toggle

4. Adjustable power caps
